title: EBB-605P — 5-Valve Piston Tuba, 6/4 BBb
text: In collaboration with Mr. Eason Zhang and the Crown Musical Instrument Factory, Elihu has developed an exclusive line of tubas and euphoniums. These are premium-quality instruments made-to-order by Mr. Zhang and his small team. Critical components such as valves and linkages were designed with the help of B-Brass in Fiumicino, Italy. After being play-tested by Elihu, each horn is cleaned and adjusted by Jon Baltimore, New York City's most trusted woodwind-brasswind technician. Instruments are available for play-testing in the Lower East Side of Manhattan. Get in touch to try these excellent instruments for yourself!
spec: 5-valve piston tuba, 6/4 BBb, 19.5" bell, 0.750" bore, 4.5" leadpipe, 4.5" main tuning slide, 3.5" first valve slide, 3.0" second valve slide, 2.5" third valve slide, 2.0" fourth valve slide, 1.5" fifth valve slide
quote1: Elihu has a rare talent; his technical facilities, his excellent musicality, and especially his endless enthusiasm have influenced positively the entire brass section.
quote2: Elihu has distinguished himself as a musician of remarkable sensitivity, intellectual curiosity, and technical brilliance, as well as a collaborative and compassionate colleague. In short, I feel like his musical potential is limitless.
quote1Name: Carlos Ágreda - Assistant conductor, LA Phil
